privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.intro: This privacy policy applies to the Babbby app ("Application") for iOS, created by Alu Studio ("Service Provider") as a free service. This service is intended for use "AS IS". By using the Application, you agree to the collection and use of information as described in this policy.

info_collection.title: Information Collection and Use
info_collection.desc: The Application may collect certain information automatically when you download and use it, through integrated third-party services. This information may include:
items: Your device's Internet Protocol address (IP address)
Device type, operating system version, and unique device identifiers
Usage data such as app feature interactions, session duration, and screens visited
info_collection.no_ads: The Application does not use advertising services and does not collect advertising identifiers (IDFA).

local_storage.title: Local Data Storage
local_storage.desc: All user-created content — including children's profiles, activity logs, completion records, and statistics — is stored exclusively on your device using a local database (GRDB/SQLite). This data is never transmitted to Alu Studio's servers or any third party. If you uninstall the Application, all local data will be permanently deleted.

iap.title: In-App Purchases
iap.desc: The Application offers an optional one-time sponsor purchase ("Buy the Developer a Coffee") through Apple's StoreKit. All payment processing is handled entirely by Apple. Alu Studio does not collect, store, or have access to any payment information, credit card details, or Apple ID credentials.

activity_disclaimer.title: Activity Recommendations
activity_disclaimer.desc: Activity recommendations provided by the Application are generated algorithmically for inspiration purposes only. They do not constitute medical, educational, psychological, or child-development advice. Parents and guardians are solely responsible for evaluating the suitability of any activity for their child.

third_party.title: Third-Party Services
third_party.desc: The Application uses the following third-party services, each with their own privacy policies governing how they handle data:

data_retention.title: Data Retention
data_retention.desc: All activity data and app settings are stored locally on your device and are never transmitted to our servers. Data collected by third-party services (Firebase Analytics, Firebase Crashlytics) is retained according to their respective data retention policies. To delete local data, uninstall the Application or clear its data through your device settings.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.desc: The Application is a tool designed for parents and guardians to plan activities for their children (ages 0–6). It is not intended for direct use by children. We do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children under 13. Children's profile information (name, birth date) is stored only on the device and never transmitted. If you believe a child has provided personal information to us, please contact us at alustudio14@gmail.com.

rights.title: Your Rights and Choices
rights.desc: Depending on your location, you may have certain rights regarding your personal data:
gdpr_items: Right to access your personal data
Right to rectify inaccurate personal data
Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten")
Right to restrict or object to data processing
rights.ccpa_desc: You have the right to know what personal information is collected, request deletion of your personal information, and opt out of the sale of your personal information. We do not sell your personal information.
opt_out_items: iOS: Go to Settings → Privacy & Security → Analytics & Improvements to manage analytics data sharing
Uninstall: You can stop all data collection by uninstalling the Application

security.title: Security
security.desc: We value the security of your information. All user data is stored locally on your device and protected by iOS's built-in security measures. However, no method of electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

changes.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.desc: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date. We encourage you to review this page periodically. Continued use of the Application after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions parents ask most about Babbby.

ages.a: Ages 0–6. Activities are matched to your child's age automatically, so you only see suggestions that fit their current stage. Babbby is a tool for parents and caregivers, not an app for children to use directly.

privacy.q: Is my activity history uploaded to the cloud?
privacy.a: No. Child profiles, activity records, completion history and statistics are all stored in a local database (GRDB/SQLite) on your device, and are never sent to Alu Studio's servers or any third party. Uninstalling the app deletes that local data permanently.

price.a: No. Babbby is free to download and use, with no subscription. The only purchase is an optional one-time tip ("buy the developer a coffee") handled entirely through Apple's StoreKit — Alu Studio never collects or sees any payment information.

activity_count.a: Over 340, across eight categories including gross motor, fine motor, language and sensory play. Babbby filters them by age automatically, and you can also browse the full library yourself.

materials.q: Can I use Babbby without special toys or equipment?
materials.a: Yes. Pick the materials you already have — crayons, a cardboard box, building blocks — and Babbby shows only the activities you can do right now. Nothing needs to be bought first.

professional.q: Are the activity suggestions professional child development advice?
professional.a: No. Every suggestion is generated algorithmically and is meant as inspiration only. It does not constitute medical, educational, psychological or child development advice. Parents and guardians decide whether any activity suits their child.

android.a: Not yet — Babbby is currently available on iOS through the App Store.
